title: Agent image: real Docker CLI with controlled daemon access
objective: Give the agent container a working Docker CLI and compose plugin so it can run a workspace's compose dependencies, while keeping the existing sandbox hardening and making daemon access opt-in and visible.

acceptance_criteria.text: agent/Dockerfile installs the Docker CLI and compose v2 plugin without breaking the existing image; docker --version and docker compose version pass in the built image.
The daemon endpoint is supplied by ./lab at run time (socket mount or DOCKER_HOST), never baked into the image. Without it, docker commands fail with a clear, documented error and no retry loop.
Existing agent protections are preserved or explicitly re-decided with evidence: non-root user, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, read-only rootfs, tmpfs homes, and memory/PID limits.
With access enabled, docker compose -f <workspace>/compose.yaml up -d and down work from inside the agent session against the VM daemon.

The #40 daemon model is implemented: rootless Docker under the dedicated mester user, with socket ownership, subuid/subgid and group handling documented and reproducible from a clean VM build. Rootful mode stays an explicit, documented escape hatch only.
Existing agent checks still pass: verify-lab, tui-jsx, exit-confirm, metrics sidecar connectivity and model server connectivity.
SECURITY.md and agent/README state exactly what Docker access the agent has when enabled and what it cannot reach.

OpenCode has an explicit reproducible version and documented image-only upgrade path: normal launches reuse the installed agent image, updating OpenCode does not require downloading/reprovisioning the VM, and Docker build-cache behavior cannot silently retain an older requested version. Read-only container self-update is not relied on; replacement is coordinated with #45 credential persistence/export and #50 regression checks.

needed: agent image build and docker/compose version check
compose up/down from inside the agent
plugin, metrics and model connectivity regression

After #41 clean provisioning/image build passes, verify first-start Docker proxy/CIDR settings, rootless security option and reboot persistence; then build/test agent Docker CLI in disposable workspace before requesting owner session migration.

OpenCode update procedure: select version, rebuild/pull agent image only (not VM/base), prove installed version changes despite Docker cache; normal relaunch does not rebuild/re-download CLI; credential export/import or persistent data survives replacement (#45).
cases: 2026-10-28 prerequisite feedback: real CachyOS guest boots and installs Docker packages but rootless installer fails on unloaded nf_tables. #41 now loads/persists the guest module and sets service drop-in before installer starts Docker; no rootful or --skip-iptables fallback. Agent CLI/daemon capability AC remain pending until live guest verification. Existing ./lab compose has GPU-local model dependencies, so running it unmodified inside CPU-only VM is not evidence of #42 completion.

2026-10-28 owner asks whether every OpenCode update needs a rebuild: current agent/Dockerfile npm-installs @opencode/cli into the image; container root is read-only. Current updates require replacing/rebuilding agent image, not full VM provisioning. Plain builds may reuse cached npm layer; no automatic version-refresh path is implemented. Version selection/targeted update remains pending A8. No image rebuild or session restart performed.
